description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon CloudFront KeyValueStore service using the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares methods for operations like deleteKey, describeKeyValueStore, getKey, listKeys, putKey, and updateKeys, with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: CloudFrontKeyValueStoreClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon CloudFront KeyValueStore service in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: deleteKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a key in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: describeKeyValueStoreAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of the KeyValueStore.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key from the KeyValueStore.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys in the KeyValueStore.

methods.name: putKey
methods.description: Adds or updates a key in the KeyValueStore.

methods.name: putKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or updates a key.

methods.name: updateKeys
methods.description: Batch updates multiple keys in the KeyValueStore.
